$Comment: The fourth step of the story, Elsie the Weaver's: bring her plant fibre for ribbon, and give one of
your presents to Bram. The _Christmas folder makes the id christmas_wrapping_presents. Npc binds it to
Elsie by the id her placement keeps in both seasons (Harvest_Feast_Weaver,
The fibre is a TURN_IN handed in at Elsie. The present is a USE_ITEM step qualified by Bram's id
(Harvest_Feast_Shepherd): holding a Christmas Present and pointing it at Bram spends it and counts here
(Item/Interactions/Christmas/Christmas_Present_Give.json). Santa's first quest hands every player one
present, the thieves drop more, and Elsie sells them. Both steps share Order 1, so either can come
first, and the fibre is handed in at Elsie, so no report-back step is added.
Its pay holds three Christmas Presents to open or give away, an Elf Suit (the item, worn whenever the
player likes) and three minutes in Santa's elf costume straight away (the Costume reward,
Christmas_Costume_Elf). A player already in a costume keeps their look and gets
Christmas_Costume_Fallback instead. It pays through Christmas_Chain_Pay, with favor on Santa's Nice
List and Festival Favor on its own Rewards. Finishing it opens Christmas Eve at Santa.
The Mmo_Xp row is MMO Skill Tree's: Crafting XP for the wrapping, waiting to be collected with the
rest. The row's own Requires, the hytale:mod_installed gate, leaves it out on a server without that
mod, unpaid and unshown, and the rest of the quest pays.
Name: Wrapping_Presents
